Extra й at the end: Trösti is Трьості.
Missing н from -nüsse: Allentnüsse is Аллентнюссе.

Utopia Park gets an unrelated name while its literal rendering Утопія-Парк sits on PlatinumScion17 (Sunny Bench), so the two look misassigned; change together with PlatinumScion17 to avoid a duplicate.
Sunny Bench carries Утопія-Парк, the literal name of PlatinumScion28 (Utopia Park); rename it so 28 can take Утопія-Парк without a duplicate.
French dj in Algerian names is дж, as in Джанет in this batch; Méridja is Мериджа.
Wrong final vowel: Sidi is Сіді.
The final French e is silent (compare Заутин); the standard form is Релізан.
Garbled spelling with йї and йі; Aïn Beïda is Айн-Бейда.
French ou is у, as in Тиндуф and Суарех; Timimoun is Тимімун.
In Salah is Ін-Салах; Ін-Шалах misspells the name and reads as 'inshallah'.
Pinyin zhong is чжун (compare Дунпін, Жунчен); Zhongguancun is Чжунгуаньцунь.
Russian-style и; Ukrainian transcription gives jing as цзін, as in Цзінань.
Extra ь: zheng is чжен (compare Ченду); Zhengzhou is Чженчжоу.
Lu'an is Лу-ань; лю would stand for liu.
Extra ь: zeng is цзен.
Russian-style и; Ukrainian transcription gives ding as дін.
Extra ь: cheng is чен, as in Ченду.
Missing нь: Gànshān is Ганьшань.
shi is ши in Ukrainian transcription, as in Шилін; Sìshǐ is Сиши.
